# WireGuard subsystem

Most often, patches will be in the usual Linux kernel repository, but
sometimes, it will be part of a sister project. You can find all of those
written here: https://www.wireguard.com/repositories/

In assessing patches, it might not be immediately obvious which one, and you
may have to look at code in these repos to figure it out.

Protocol and crypto info might be found in:
https://www.wireguard.com/papers/wireguard.pdf

The contents of networking-core.md and networking-drivers.md are as equally as
important as this file.
